svg.title: Three EasyCRT gear layouts
svg.desc: Three ways to mount the two EasyCRT encoder pinions on a turret: on the turret gear, on the motor drive gear, or on their own common gear. In each layout the gear both pinions mesh with is the shared gear, and solve returns its angle.

g.text: 1. CRT gears on the turret gear
Drive gear and both pinions mesh with the turret gear.
2. CRT gears on the drive gear
Both pinions mesh with the gear on the motor output.
3. CRT gears on a common gear
Both pinions mesh with their own gear on the turret gear.
